description: This file defines the 'DroppingMessageMapper' class which implements the 'MessageMapper' interface. Its purpose is to ensure that any mapped messages are dropped, returning empty lists for both 'map' methods. It is a unit within the messaging service of the Eclipse Ditto connectivity module, specifically for handling message mapping with a no-op behavior.

classes.name: DroppingMessageMapper
classes.description: Implementation of MessageMapper that drops all messages, effectively ignoring all input messages and outputting empty lists.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Overrides the configuration method but performs no configuration actions, ignoring its parameters.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Overloaded method that returns an empty list, effectively dropping the message, for both ExternalMessage and Adaptable inputs.
